say:3:1210715001:0.text: Oh, it's just you. Do you enjoy slinking around in the shadows all the time? Ugh, you're so dark and gloomy! It ruins my mood.
say:3:1210715001:0.source_cn: 啊，是你。你很喜欢偷听吗？

say:4:1210715002:0.text: Nara, are you wasting these two specimens?
say:4:1210715002:0.source_cn: 奈拉，你浪费了两个材料。

say:5:1210715003:0.text: Hey! I caught these two with my own hands. I have the right to deal with them. The captain gave me that authority!
say:5:1210715003:0.source_cn: 那两个家伙是我抓的，任我处置，船长说我有这个权利！

say:6:1210715004:0.text: The day of reckoning is coming soon. The captain invested such precious power in you. I hope you do not disappoint him.
say:6:1210715004:0.source_cn: ……决战日快到了，船长把那么珍贵的力量用在了你身上，别...

say:7:1210715005:0.text: Go back to the shadows and loom over someone else. I'm tired of your yapping.
say:7:1210715005:0.source_cn: 真吵啊，这些话早都听腻了。

say:8:1210715006:0.text: Hmm. I bet you're really scared of letting him down, aren't you?
say:8:1210715006:0.source_cn: 我看是你……很害怕让他失望吧？

say:10:1210715008:0.text: If it weren't for the captain's orders, I'd have taken your head off ten times over. Imagine it, dangling from a hook—such a delightful decoration!
say:10:1210715008:0.source_cn: 要不是船长拦着，你的头早被我割下来十次了。串在钩索上会...

say:11:1210715009:0.text: I've made my stance clear. Proceed as you wish.
say:11:1210715009:0.source_cn: 够了。该提醒的我都提醒了，你好自为之。

say:14:1210715011:0.text: Now that's ruined my mood, I should go back to doing something fun! Back to my two little playthings... Let me think...
say:14:1210715011:0.source_cn: 来人，把这两个人……我想想……

say:15:1210715012:0.text: Oh, I know! Guard! Come put a noose around the man, and give the rope to the woman!
say:15:1210715012:0.source_cn: 男的吊起来，绳子给女的。

say:16:1210715013:0.text: *Evil giggle* Seeing as you, good sir, just lied to this pretty lady, she's probably dying to kill you. I'll give her the rope that decides your fate. Let's see if she saves you. It'll be sooo interesting!
say:16:1210715013:0.source_cn: 嘿！你刚骗了她，她恨不能杀了你。我把掌握你命运的绳子给...

say:18:1210715014:0.text: N-no! Wait! I'll die for sure, please!
say:18:1210715014:0.source_cn: 不！别！我会死的——不要，不要！

say:19:1210715015:0.text: Hahaha! Hearing you beg is so exhilarating. But why are you begging me? Shouldn't you be begging that little lady for your life?
say:19:1210715015:0.source_cn: 哈哈哈哈……！求我，不如求她！

say:20:1210715016:0.text: Anyways... These two are no fun anymore. Let's find some other entertainment.
say:20:1210715016:0.source_cn: 哈哈…这俩人没意思了，去找点别的乐子。
